description: This bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," illustrates the runtime in seconds for a single model, "Our Joint Framework," and four LLM models—ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude—when operating in a streaming environment. The vertical axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," is scaled linearly from 0 to 400, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 50. The horizontal axis lists the five models as categories. A legend in the top-left corner indicates that the green bars represent "Our Joint Framework" and the light blue bars represent "LLM Models." The chart displays one green bar for "Our Joint Framework" with a value of 77 seconds. For the LLM models, the light blue bars show the following runtimes: ChatGPT at 190 seconds, DeepSeek at 365 seconds, LLaMA at 172 seconds, and Claude at 243 seconds. The bars are arranged in the order of the model names on the horizontal axis and are not sorted by height. Each bar is labeled with its exact runtime value directly above it. The green bar for "Our Joint Framework" is visually distinct from the light blue bars for the LLM models.
